subject: Modifying legend when geom_abline is used

messages.author: 277acf887029f113
messages.subject: Modifying legend when geom_abline is used
parts:
Anyway to exclude the line through the symbols in the legend in the
following simplified example?

n=100
x=data.frame(x=floor(runif(n)*10),y=floor(runif(n)*10),n=floor(runif(n)*50))
ggplot(x,aes(x,y,size=n))
+geom_point(shape=15)+geom_abline(intercept=0,slope=1)+ylim(0,10)+xlim(0,10)
